question: seed18 scored 39.9 and seed17 152.8 on the same weights; is that window difficulty or noise?

difficulty_proxy.note: the BEST constant is nearly identical across windows (245.5-272), but the MEAN constant is not: that gap is the difficulty proxy to test

verdict.reading: seed18 is the hardest window by the mean-constant proxy (87.1 vs 105.9-127.8), and the arm's per-window ranking matches that proxy exactly (4/4: 18, 11, 12, 17), so its low score is consistent with window difficulty rather than a specific failure; BUT the between-window spread (sd 40.2) is only HALF the within-window spread (mean sd 80.3), so at n=20 per window the ranking itself is not established; the sharper signal is that the arm's advantage over random is monotone in window breadth (-10.8, -5.9, +31.3, +43.1), exact one-sided p=0.0417 over 4 ranks -- suggestive, not significant, and it is the only pattern here that is not just noise
verdict.advantage_reading: the arm-vs-random advantage increases monotonically with the mean-constant difficulty proxy: it only wins on the broader windows (n=4 ranks, exact one-sided p=0.0417 -- a hint, not a test)
